Amazon's early fall Prime Day deals are now officially live, but we're also tracking pre-order early bird discounts across a range of Apple Watch Series 12 configurations and the all-new black Apple Watch Ultra 4, with shipments going out throughout the week. Amazon has also knocked the all-new AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation down to $125 early, alongside $50 off AirPods Pro 3 ongoing, but beyond that we have up to $450 off M5 Pro MacBook Pro configs, $150 off M5 MacBook Air, and a whole bunch of Anker charging accessory deals to cover below.

Amazon's early fall Prime Day sale is now live: Apple, Pixel, Anker, Grubhub $20 off, and more

All-new AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation early down to $125 with Friday delivery, or $199 AirPods Pro 3

  • AirPods Pro 3 — $199 (was $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 — $449 (was $549)
  • AirPods 5 — $125 (was $129)
  • AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case — $149

Pre-order early bird deals now appearing on a range of Apple Watch Series 12 models at Amazon

The all-new Apple Watch Series 12 can now be at your door within 48 hours, and just like the AirPods 5 down at $125, multiple configurations are seeing pre-order early bird deals at Amazon. These slight discounts first surfaced earlier in the week at Amazon, and now we're seeing additional case color, size, and band style options joining them — we've rounded them all up below.

Of course, we're not talking about massive price drops here, but rather the best cash discounts you can find anywhere before the all-new Series 12 officially goes on sale. If you're still looking to lock in a pre-order this week and get it as soon as possible, Amazon has the lowest prices and nearly all models (at the time of writing) can still ship out by Friday:

  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm — $490 (was $499)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm — $679 (was $699)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm Milanese Loop edition — $729 (was $749)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 46mm — $440 (was $449)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 46mm — $540 (was $549)

Black Apple Watch Ultra 4 with all-new translucent band sees first pre-order discount, lands at Amazon

  • Apple Watch Ultra 4 Black — from $780 (was $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4 Natural — from $780 (was $799)

These M5 and M5 Pro MacBook Pro configs are down up to $450 today (24GB and 48GB models)

While Amazon has the lowest prices on the AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch Series 12 pre-orders, its MacBook Pro deals have been a bit rarer of late. We did catch $500 off the higher-end Pro models, and B&H has three different configurations down from $320 to $450 today. Details below.

B&H is one of our favorite Apple authorized resellers and regularly goes toe-to-toe with Amazon and the big-box retailers on MacBook deals — today is one of those days.

B&H has the lowest prices on three specific models, including the M5 down $320 with an upgraded 96W charger, and a pair of M5 Pro models down up to $450:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB — $1,899 (was $2,219)
  • Free 96W Apple charger ($20 value) included
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB — $2,349 (was $2,799)
  • With upgraded 18-core/20-core
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB — $2,899 (was $3,299)

For comparison, Amazon doesn't even carry the 48GB M5 Pro config, nor the 24GB model with the upgraded cores above — and Amazon charges more than this for the same 15-core/16-core variant.
